description: This file defines the `GLShape` class, which manages a 3D shape including vertices, faces, and transformations within an OpenGL-like graphics framework. It provides methods for adding faces and vertices, setting face colors, handling transformations, and exporting indices for rendering.

classes.name: GLShape
classes.description: Represents a 3D shape composed of vertices and faces with transformation capabilities.

methods.name: GLShape
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shape with a reference to the world context.

methods.name: addFace
methods.description: Adds a face to the shape.

methods.name: setFaceColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a specified face.

methods.name: putIndices
methods.description: Outputs the indices of all faces into a buffer for rendering.

methods.name: getIndexCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of indices across all faces.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to the shape, reusing existing vertices with the same coordinates if available.

methods.name: animateTransform
methods.description: Applies an animation transformation to the shape's vertices.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Prepares the shape for animation (empty implementation).

methods.name: endAnimation
methods.description: Finalizes the animation, updating the transformation matrix.
